row.quote_en: In the case of DHPCs, the responsibility for evaluating the distribution of the DHPC it has prepared lies with the marketing authorisation holder, and it should report the outcome and any difficulties identified (e.g. problems with the recipient list, timing or the distribution mechanism) to the Agency. The necessary measures should be taken to correct the situation or to prevent similar problems in the future.
row.title: Evaluate DHPC distribution, report results and difficulties to TITCK and take corrective action
row.statement: The MAH is responsible for evaluating the distribution of the DHPC it prepared and should report the outcome and any difficulties identified (e.g. recipient list, timing or distribution mechanism problems) to TITCK; the necessary measures should be taken to correct the situation or prevent similar problems.
